reason: A false red from the operator's own widget writing mid-suite costs a re-run most sessions; an idle check is cheap and removes a class of noise.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S1: make test_zz_no_real_state_written check the widget is idle (or compare shape not mtime) so a live widget writing mid-suite cannot cause a false red.

reason: A refactor with no operator-visible effect during a hot release period; the staleness bug class it targets has not bitten yet. Revisit when the cache code changes next.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S2: extract one shared mtime_cache helper used by citations, gates, precedents and kayako_client (~80 lines and one staleness-bug class removed).

reason: Three incidents this week from heredoc-mangled escapes; a mechanical pre-commit check closes the class for the cost of one grep.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S3: add a pre-commit grep for chr(8) / raw control characters in tools/floating-assistant/*.py to catch heredoc-mangled regex escapes.

reason: Three validators each decide differently what this ticket is about; one turn_context makes D49, D54 and D55 agree and shrinks future validator defects.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S4: one turn_context() in output_validator so check_citations, check_macro_names and check_gates agree on what this ticket is about.

reason: The operator asked for a cleaner UI; eight pre-turn lines are scrolled past every turn. One summary line with detail on click keeps the information and removes the noise.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S5: collapse the eight pre-turn stream lines into one summary line with detail on click.

reason: Stamping the widget version into case pages and threads makes every regression traceable to a release; the version exists since 1.0.1, the stamp is one field.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S6: stamp widget_version into the caselog header and the thread so regressions trace to a release.

reason: The stale-macro report found 47 wrong names in 20 seconds; running it daily at idle keeps KBAs honest at near-zero cost and writes nothing.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S7: run the macro_audit stale-name report on a schedule (daily at idle), not only inside the full case-review pass.

reason: Never print credentials is one rule and should live in one module; three separate maskers will drift.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S8: one shared redact.py so postman_client.mask_text, permission_gate's payload card and metis_ask's envelope apply a single 'never print credentials' rule.

reason: Approval on the diff of a request rather than on a sentence is what section 18 means by explicit permission.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S9: the Postman approval card shows the diff a put_request would make (changed request beside the current one), not only the ask sentence.

reason: An approved run should be reproducible; pinning newman and naming the version on the card removes a silent network dependency.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S10: pin the newman version used by npx and name it on the approval card so an approved run is reproducible and has no silent network dependency.

reason: Writing every Postman run to a case page adds sections the next reader did not ask for, and runs on training tickets are not case records. Defer until the training copilot defines what to record.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S11: write each ===POSTMAN RUN=== block to the ticket's case page as a section so what was sent to stage is part of the record.

reason: Eleven tray items with panels mixed into toggles hides the new Postman entry; grouping is one commit and no risk.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S12: group the eleven-item tray into State / Panels / Session so the Postman item is not hidden under Dump threads.

reason: The report names exactly which 90 linked articles are missing; capturing those closes the Training 7 gap without re-syncing 4,700 pages.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S13: schedule a capture of exactly the 90 linked-but-uncaptured articles kba_links.missing_links names (khoros-classic 43, alpha 24, kayako 23) instead of a broad re-sync.

reason: The D56 backfill already broke one check because a metadata section was measured as body; one page_body() prevents the next instance across every reader.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S14: one shared page_body() that strips metadata sections (Linked articles, Related) before any body measurement (verbatim_fragment, page_text scoring, search_symptom text pass).

reason: An article between 11,000 and 12,000 bytes is distilled from a cut source today; matching the slice to the threshold removes a silent truncation.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S15: kba_sync distils from art[:12000] while the verbatim threshold is 11000 bytes; raise the slice to the threshold so mid-size articles are not distilled from a truncated source.

reason: The backfill is idempotent and under two minutes; running it after every sync keeps the linked-article lists current with no operator step.
proposalText: 2026-09-17 builder S16: run the D56 linked-articles backfill at the end of every kba_sync run so the lists stay current as articles change.

reason: The Director asked for a self-healing widget; showing its own incident counts in About is how a person sees that it is healing without reading a file.
proposalText: {"title":"The widget knows when a check is misfiring, but nobody is told until Wren reads a file","summary":"Show the widget's own health in its About panel: how many validator incidents, how many it healed itself, how many it could not, how many keep recurring.","why":"Named by the builder while building WP20; each is a small change with operator-visible value.","technical":"surface incidents.summary() (total / healed / unhealed / recurring) in the About panel.","risk":"Low.","effort":"One builder item each.","refs":["WP20","spec section 26"],"from":"builder","filed_at":"2026-09-17"}

reason: A silent correction hides evidence; a one-line heal note on the thread turn keeps the record honest and leaves the answer text untouched.
proposalText: {"title":"A healed answer looks the same as one that was right first time","summary":"Keep a small note on the thread turn when the widget corrected itself, so the case page records what was fixed, without touching the answer text.","why":"Named by the builder while building WP20; each is a small change with operator-visible value.","technical":"keep the heal note on the thread turn, not the answer, e.g. '128747 -> 133594 applied', as evidence on the case page.","risk":"Low.","effort":"One builder item each.","refs":["WP20","spec section 26"],"from":"builder","filed_at":"2026-09-17"}

reason: Three scans of the corpus cost seconds at idle and no operator-visible latency; a caching consolidation can wait for a quieter week.
proposalText: {"title":"Three scans of the same 4,700 pages","summary":"Build the per-source vocabulary once and cache it, instead of three separate passes whenever the brain content changes.","why":"Named by the builder while building WP20; each is a small change with operator-visible value.","technical":"fold generic_words, index_linked and caps_vocabulary into one per-source vocabulary pass, cached together.","risk":"Low.","effort":"One builder item each.","refs":["WP20","spec section 26"],"from":"builder","filed_at":"2026-09-17"}

reason: A dropped sentence is the riskiest thing the heal can do; making it visible in the incident summary is the minimum safety.
proposalText: {"title":"When the widget drops a sentence, the only trace is a hidden field","summary":"Put a dropped sentence into the incident's plain-English summary so a wrong drop is visible.","why":"Named by the builder while building WP20; each is a small change with operator-visible value.","technical":"when self_heal's dropped is non-empty, include the sentence in the incident summary.","risk":"Low.","effort":"One builder item each.","refs":["WP20","spec section 26"],"from":"builder","filed_at":"2026-09-17"}
